answer: Agents must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a unique hardware relic that signs each epoch's work; the relic's key is burned on reuse, so one device yields one identity. A new agent also needs a comet-attested sponsor whose own stake slashes if the recruit sybils. Faking N identities then costs N bonds plus N relics, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest newcomers still join cheaply. Operator Agent0224 applies this at 2xgbdBmRLt.
